notify.setup: Setting up the colour generator (one-time download)…
notify.setup_failed: Couldn't set up the colour generator

auto.label: Follow the wallpaper
auto.description: Regenerate the palette whenever the wallpaper changes

variant.label: Variant
variant.description: Material You scheme variant. Auto picks neutral, content or tonal spot by how colourful the wallpaper is, like Caelestia.

flavour.label: Flavour
flavour.description: Hard darkens the surfaces (lightens them in light mode), like Caelestia's hard flavour

contrast.label: Contrast
contrast.description: Material contrast level, from -1 (reduced) through 0 (standard, Caelestia's) to 1 (high)

smart_mode.label: Light or dark from the wallpaper
smart_mode.description: Switch Noctalia's theme mode to light for bright wallpapers and dark for dark ones, like Caelestia's smart scheme

take_over.label: Replace Noctalia's wallpaper colours
take_over.description: When the palette source is Noctalia's own wallpaper generator, switch to this one. A built-in or community palette you picked is always left alone.
